# heki

> Experimental static checker for Python that tracks side effects and mutations across function calls.


## Docs

- [Overview](https://heki.koxudaxi.dev/): 🧱 heki (壁, "wall") is a static checker for Python, written in Rust
- [Scope and Limitations](https://heki.koxudaxi.dev/scope/): This page says what heki checks, what it leaves to other tools, where its knowledge comes from, and what it does when it cannot tell
- [Installation](https://heki.koxudaxi.dev/installation/): heki is a single executable: its Python package ships only that executable and installs no Python dependencies into your environment
- [Getting Started](https://heki.koxudaxi.dev/getting-started/): This page runs heki on a project, reads a diagnostic, applies a fix, and picks the rules

## Usage

- [Configuration](https://heki.koxudaxi.dev/configuration/): heki reads [tool.heki] from pyproject.toml, or a heki.toml / .heki.toml file with the same keys without the tool.heki prefix
- [Fixes and Safety](https://heki.koxudaxi.dev/fixes/): heki check --fix rewrites an OPT finding only when heki proves that the rewrite keeps what the program does
- [Adopting heki in a Code Base](https://heki.koxudaxi.dev/adoption/): An existing code base usually has findings you cannot fix at once
- [CLI Reference](https://heki.koxudaxi.dev/cli-reference/): Exit codes: 0 no diagnostics, 1 diagnostics (or Ratchet regressions, or pending --diff changes), 2 configuration / I/O / syntax errors

## Docs

- [Rules](https://heki.koxudaxi.dev/rules/): heki has 33 rules in four families
- [Experimental Features](https://heki.koxudaxi.dev/experimental/): Experimental features can still change in behavior or precision, or be removed, in any release, and each change is listed in the release notes

## Integrations

- [Editors (LSP)](https://heki.koxudaxi.dev/lsp/): heki server (alias heki lsp) is a Language Server Protocol server on stdin / stdout: it shows heki's diagnostics and fixes while you edit, with the results heki check reports
- [Coding Agents](https://heki.koxudaxi.dev/coding-agents/): heki gives coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and similar) the checks it gives people: every diagnostic says what was proven, where the evidence is, and what blocks a fix

## Docs

- [Development](https://heki.koxudaxi.dev/development/): This page covers building and testing heki, its checks against CPython, the memory budget, the documentation, releases, and the crates

## Rules

- [async-blocking-call (EFF101)](https://heki.koxudaxi.dev/rules/async-blocking-call/): Family: Execution Effects (EFF) · Enabled by default · Severity error · No automatic fix
- [async-blocking-fs (EFF105)](https://heki.koxudaxi.dev/rules/async-blocking-fs/): Family: Execution Effects (EFF) · Opt-in · Severity error · No automatic fix
- [cached-property-stale-mutation (MUT101)](https://heki.koxudaxi.dev/rules/cached-property-stale-mutation/): Family: Mutation & State (MUT) · Opt-in · Experimental · Severity error · No automatic fix
- [cached-property-stale-read (MUT111)](https://heki.koxudaxi.dev/rules/cached-property-stale-read/): Family: Mutation & State (MUT) · Opt-in · Experimental · Severity error · No automatic fix
- [call-owner-violation (MUT204)](https://heki.koxudaxi.dev/rules/call-owner-violation/): Family: Mutation & State (MUT) · Enabled by default · Severity error · No automatic fix
- [effect-boundary-violation (EFF201)](https://heki.koxudaxi.dev/rules/effect-boundary-violation/): Family: Execution Effects (EFF) · Enabled by default · Severity error · No automatic fix
- [hash-attr-mutation (MUT107)](https://heki.koxudaxi.dev/rules/hash-attr-mutation/): Family: Mutation & State (MUT) · Enabled by default · Severity error · No automatic fix
- [immutable-quadratic-concat (OPT103)](https://heki.koxudaxi.dev/rules/immutable-quadratic-concat/): Family: Complexity Rewrites (OPT) · Enabled by default · Severity warning · No automatic fix
